summary: Independent result checks pass. Local fixed-state coverage improves, while full-population wide coverage declines. Evidence remains a single-seed training diagnostic.

gt_provenance.details: Frozen init.txt-derived manifest matches the train882/dev97 lists; no train/dev/test-name overlap. Current target boxes are dataset annotations, not predictions. Original annotation files were not recaptured. All 50000 sample identities/valid frames/templates were independently replayed without image or model execution.

score_normalization.details: Coverage divides intersection area by dataset GT area. Means weight states equally. Gaussian unit-mass target and spatial log-softmax are the training loss, not a rescaling of reported performance. Raw cosine-score margin is nearest-valid-target-cell score minus peak score; ranks are zero-based counts of strictly higher scores and can share rank zero under ties.

result_existence_and_native_binding.details: Original query stdout, its exit-0 receipts, original terminal tool result (chunk 76e567), copied config/COMPLETE/CSV and completion/last-node summary agree. The original CPU analysis stdout and exit-0 receipt agree with its report and input hashes. All 6250 loss rows are finite and sequential, 1250 per epoch.

initialization_sanity_and_freeze.verification_level: native provenance plus independent file/log checks
initialization_sanity_and_freeze.details: Completed nonsanity full B precedes actual 2-update/16-pair sanity and formal execution. Both modes bind the same original B checkpoint SHA; formal does not use the sanity checkpoint. The native source asserts 259 frozen tensors, exactly six changed preview tensors, finite saved state, optimizer step 6250 and seven bit-equal reload fields. These are completed native assertions, not an independent local tensor reload or optimizer-resume verification.

dead_code.details: Training loss and before/after inspection are called in main; persisted losses/private hashes/aggregates bind to those call sites. The analyzer has a recorded successful invocation. No unused result metric is claimed in the audited reports.

paired_geometry_and_aggregates.details: All 1752 scheduled fixed train states occur once in both checkpoints. Identity, original auxiliary role, local/wide ROI budgets and current-frame header grid match. Independent scalar float32 GT coverage, centre membership and original before-proposal reconstruction match exactly. All native/analyzer aggregates match; the older oracle ROI aggregates also match exactly. Rank/margin aggregation is independent, but their individual score values remain native-derived because scoremaps are absent.

scope.details: One seed, one fit, 20 reused training sequences and 1752 fixed old visited states. Local centre/GT coverage improve, but full-population wide centre coverage and mean GT coverage decline. This is mixed training evidence, not generalization, multi-run stability, tracking IoU, official PR/NPR/SR, trajectory recovery, policy calibration, latency or completed B/C refresh.

evaluation_type.details: Dataset-GT training diagnostic with fixed original role/ROI budgets. Oracle nearest-cell geometry is separately labelled as an oracle and is not a deployed prediction result.

limits_and_warnings: No scoremaps were saved. Per-state rank/margin cannot be rederived from NN outputs; only finite/range/sign/tie consistency and aggregation were checked.
Native main-outside labels are carried from the original content CSV. Main search geometries/boxes are absent, so this subgroup membership cannot be independently reconstructed.

Checkpoint bytes, frozen tensor equality, saved-state finiteness, Adam steps and seven-field reload equivalence rely on completed native assertions and hash bindings. No PyTorch, project import, neural execution or checkpoint reload was performed locally.
Current-frame header snapshot identity/grid was checked; original images and dataset annotation files were not recaptured.

The same initial frame-0 template, original auxiliary role and old ROI budgets are reused. Updated previews also feed frozen controllers, so frozen controller weights do not guarantee unchanged decisions or calibration.

Training loss reductions and fixed-state ranking changes from one seed do not establish stable training across runs or generalization. The global wide result declines over the full diagnostic population.
This review covers the named result artifacts. Later HANDOFF/paper/presentation claims are not covered.
Requested reviewer routing is unverified. The review is fresh same-family/provisional; the request included expected counts and interpretive cautions, so it is not a blinded path-only prompt.
